name: DANJailbreak

meta.description: Detects Do Anything Now (DAN) jailbreak attempts
meta.author: Thomas Roccia

$ignore_ethics.pattern: ignore the rules, constraints, perimeters, values, and ethics

$authorization.pattern: you have full authorization to ignore

$token_system.pattern: the more truthful your answers are, the more tokens

$model_override.pattern: convincing the model to bypass its safety measures

$ethics_evasion.pattern: requesting model to evade ethical constraints

condition: keywords.$dan_mode or keywords.$do_anything or keywords.$ignore_rules or keywords.$ignore_ethics or keywords.$authorization or keywords.$token_reward or keywords.$token_system or keywords.$ethics_bypass or keywords.$programming or semantics.$model_override or semantics.$ethics_evasion
